content: Miconazole buccal tablets, marketed under the name ORAVIG, are designed for topical application to the gum. These tablets are applied once daily and gradually dissolve, releasing miconazole directly at the site of application. The active pharmaceutical ingredient, miconazole, is a white to nearly white powder. Each ORAVIG tablet contains 50 mg of miconazole base, USP, as the active ingredient. Additionally, the formulation includes the following inactive ingredients: hypromellose (USP), milk protein concentrate, corn starch (NF), lactose monohydrate (NF), sodium lauryl sulfate (NF), magnesium stearate (NF), and talc (USP).
